Topic 7.1: Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reforms introduced by Prophet Muhammad. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.
